metric_reproduction.aggregation: within-seed fivefold probability mean -> metric; Macro mean of T0/T1/T2; four-seed metric mean and sample SD (ddof=1)
metric_reproduction.source_access: bundle-local copied result JSON/CSV only; no source-project paths, manifests, MRI/training inputs, checkpoint loads or GPU
metric_reproduction.scope: point metrics, validation thresholds and seed SD; frozen bootstrap intervals/p-values are included in manuscript/data but not rerun here
metric_reproduction.audit_limit: report-level patient/label alignment and validation/test exclusion only; original training-cohort manifest membership is not re-audited

limitations: Bootstrap intervals and p values are archived; they were not rerun during this packaging.
Original analysis sources retain historical paths; the independent result verifier is portable.
